# Complete SEST combat cost coverage

Generated from the resolved collection and vanilla definitions. Prices are USD per represented item. Existing usable prices remain authoritative; remaining prices are SEST family comparisons or rough replacement models. These models implement the owner's request for coverage with estimates, and are not independently confirmed procurement quotes.

Historical model prices use configured service-year CPI backcasts where a year exists; otherwise they are explicitly 2026 replacement proxies. The 2026 CPI value is a Q2-based estimate. Ranges are sensitivity bands, not statistical confidence intervals.

Ammunition, embarked aircraft, removable pods and tank contents are excluded from fitted platform estimates. A pod's own estimate covers its hardware, and its rounds are separate. Personnel, visual helpers and simulated processes have an explicit non-procured disposition. Native tracker limitations and the SEST debrief extension are described in README.md.

| Kind | References | Historical prices | Current prices |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| weapon | 2170 | 2170 | 2170 |
| vessel | 937 | 937 | 937 |
| aircraft | 756 | 756 | 756 |
| land | 502 | 502 | 502 |

Preserved 5445 pre-existing usable price fields. Filled 3285 missing fields. No acquisition-point field was used as USD.

## Model and research sources

- SEST owner-authorized replacement-cost model, 24 October 2026: https://github.com/SEST-HOBBY/Seapower-mods/blob/fix/complete-combat-costs-20261024/integration/combat-costs/coverage-policy.json
- Combat Cost Tracker 0.7.1 captured catalog estimates; retain original reference-year basis: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3807187341
- Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis CPI table: 2026 value is a Q2-based estimate, not a final annual index: https://www.minneapolisfed.org/about-us/monetary-policy/inflation-calculator/consumer-price-index-1913-
- FY2026 Mandatory Funding Allocation Plan: $40M/22,435 SSQ-53 and $40M/3,076 SSQ-125B are allocation-derived comparators, not individual contract quotes: https://comptroller.war.gov/Portals/45/Documents/news/FY2026_Mandatory_Funding_Allocation_Plan.pdf
- Navy PB2026 OPN BA3, Sonobuoys P-5, page 7: SSQ-125B $11K-$15K vendor ROM: https://www.secnav.navy.mil/fmc/fmb/Documents/26pres/OPN_BA3_Book.pdf
- Navy PB2020 PANMC, Airborne Rockets P-40a: LAU-68 F/A $19,000 and LAU-61 G/A $52,188.40, launcher hardware excluding separate rockets: https://www.secnav.navy.mil/fmc/fmb/Documents/20pres/PANMC_BOOK.pdf
